stable.notes: Talk time per voice in the speaker sheet: minutes and share of voice beside each row, shown only where the panel actually names the voice. Shares are a share of named speech and total 100%. Below 60% identified the header says so instead of drawing shares, because unattributed is routinely the largest slice and a percentage there invites reading the missing majority as a person. Needs glasses-server 6.21.27; older servers omit the numbers rather than showing zeros.
